Japan-Manchoukuo Year Book 1936

Japan-Manchoukuo Year Book Co., Tokyo, 1936

Complete scan, except that pp. iv–v of the printed contents pp. 450–451 (Japan, Manufacturing Industries) and pp. 746–747 (Manchoukuo, Transportation) are missing. All statistical tables and columnar lists, the Who's Who, the business directory, the bibliography, the learned and social institutions, the diplomatic and consular lists, the import and export tariffs, the map index and the dated chronologies are transcribed; the running text, photographs, maps, advertisements and charts without printed figures are not. Pages with tables were found from contact sheets. Sonnet 5.5 agents read most pages and Opus 5.5 agents the large or difficult tables; every printed total was re-added, and totals that did not reconcile were re-read on zoomed crops by Opus 5.5 — where the print itself does not add up, the figures are kept as printed and noted. Figures lost in the binding gutter are marked unreadable. The book's printed contents, with every chapter and section linked to its page of the scan, are on the contents page; Japan chapters IX–XXVI, whose contents page is missing, are listed from their opening pages.
